task_description: Full modern UI and architecture overhaul of the Selamsew portfolio frontend. Dark-first design with indigo/purple gradient accents (#6366f1 -> #8b5cf6), glassmorphism cards, smooth scroll animations, unified Skills section, vertical timeline for Experience/Education, responsive project grid with filter tabs. New file structure: src/hooks/, src/layouts/, src/sections/ (move sections from components/). New reusable primitives in src/components/. All existing content and API integrations preserved. Build must pass with zero errors.
